title: hydrangea hirsuta
intro: Hydrangea hirsuta, commonly known as hairy hydrangea, is a deciduous shrub native to North America, characterized by its distinctive hairy leaves and stems. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and pain, due to its potential health benefits of reducing fever and relieving menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea hirsuta include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
